map.儿童牙弓发育评估器 使用指南: Child Dental Arch Development Assessor User Guide
map.输入年龄与牙弓测量数据，判断牙列发育阶段、间隙需求与早期矫治时机，供正畸参考。: Enter age and arch measurements to judge the dentition development stage, space requirements and early treatment timing for orthodontic reference.
map.替牙期儿童牙弓狭窄，输入年龄与宽度，工具对照参考范围提示扩弓时机。: For children in the replacement period with a narrow arch, enter age and width and the tool flags the timing for arch expansion against the reference range.
map.前牙拥挤评估可用间隙与必需间隙差，判断是否需要序列拔牙或早期矫治。: Anterior crowding can be assessed from the difference between available and required space, to judge whether serial extraction or early treatment is needed.
map.骨性畸形筛查，提示上颌/下颌发育不调的就诊指征。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛: Screen for skeletal malocclusion and flag referral indications for maxillary/mandibular developmental imbalance. (Results are for oral health education and self-screening reference only, and do not replace oral examination, periapical/CBCT imaging, or professional diagnosis and treatment by dentists, orthodontists and periodontists; if you have toothache, bleeding gums, ulcers that will not heal, abnormal oral mucosa or bite discomfort, seek care promptly at a qualified hospital dental department.)

map.牙弓发育分哪些阶段？: What stages does arch development go through?
map.大致乳牙列、混合牙列、恒牙列期；替牙期是间隙管理与 early 矫治的关键窗口，: Roughly the primary dentition, mixed dentition and permanent dentition stages; the replacement period is the key window for space management and early treatment and needs regular monitoring.
map.牙弓狭窄有什么后果？: What are the consequences of a narrow arch?
map.易导致拥挤、错位与咬合不正，严重骨性狭窄可在生长高峰期扩弓，具体由正畸科医师判断: It easily causes crowding, misalignment and malocclusion; severe skeletal narrowing can be expanded during the growth peak, with the decision left to the orthodontist.
map.什么时候该看正畸？: When should you see an orthodontist?
map.明显拥挤、反颌、开唇露齿或替牙异常，建议 7 岁左右做正畸初筛；本工具仅为参考。: Obvious crowding, crossbite, lip incompetence or abnormal replacement warrants an orthodontic screening around age 7; this tool is for reference only.
